answer_1.quote: We evaluate our proposal on 12 datasets from four categories of reasoning tasks: arithmetic, commonsense, symbolic, and other logical reasoning tasks...

answer_2.quote: We carefully craft three automated evaluation indicators. We first devise a general metric, SCR dim, which assesses responses according to detailed requirements across the three basic and three advanced evaluation dimensions...

answer_3.quote: For evaluation, we take the sota GPT-4 as the evaluator. We also use LLMs to generate scoring points and compute semantic similarity between responses and reference solutions...

answer_4.quote: We conduct a blind A/B human evaluation on a subset of the responses given by different methods. Human judges were presented with a question and two candidate responses and asked to select the better one...
answer_4.guideline: Human judges were asked to select the response that is better overall between two candidates.
